traits.label: Imported unfree labor
traits.reviewReason: The positive frozen cells describe dispossessed Khoikhoi incorporated as servants within their own homeland. They do not establish a distinct population brought from elsewhere as unfree labor. Imported African and Asian slave labor existed at the Cape but is outside this Khoikhoi-bounded successor and cannot be borrowed into its public trait.
traits.underlyingRecodeFollowup: Review scs_exogenous_labor_triad=4 and pel_unfree_incomer_share=3 against the successor boundary in the next statistical release; the current positive referents are local affected people, not imported incomers. Do not mutate v5.

modern-libya-tawergha-expulsion.familyPublicOverrideRationale: Same label reached de novo; no frozen family evidence or score inherited.

traits.label: Government direction
traits.reviewReason: OHCHR identifies Misrata-based armed groups in the 2011 attack; later governmental bodies appear in agreements and return policy. The sources do not establish one centralized, explicit and continuously state-directed operation.

traits.label: Legal and property machinery
traits.reviewReason: Town and home destruction and later property disputes are supported, but seizure, title transfer, cadastral expropriation, surveying or a formal proprietary program are not.

traits.label: Settler implantation
traits.reviewReason: No incoming replacement population is identified. This rules out asserting implantation; it does not turn source silence into a measured zero.

traits.label: Elimination over incorporation
traits.reviewReason: Whole-town displacement and years of blocked return support the removal component; partial return later occurred, and demographic replacement or an incorporation regime is not established. The mixed factor therefore receives no point.

traits.label: Lethal coercion
traits.reviewReason: OHCHR documents murder, torture, cruel treatment and town destruction. No event-specific death total, mortality share or uniform experience supports a numeric intensity.

traits.label: Durability of outcome
traits.reviewReason: Blocked return persisted for years, followed by partial return while a residual displaced population and barriers remained through 2025. The outcome is persistent but partially reversed, with post-2025 status held.

traits.label: Separation from homeland
traits.reviewReason: OHCHR reports dispersal across Libya and some flight abroad; IOM reports displacement across more than 30 municipalities. Complete distances, routes and destinations are unavailable, and partial return occurred.

traits.label: Imported unfree labor
traits.reviewReason: The bounded event concerns expulsion and return of Tawergha residents. No imported unfree-labor cohort is identified; no broader absence claim is made.

traits.label: Government direction
traits.highMeans: More centralized, explicit, and continuously state-directed organization.
traits.reviewReason: Maʻafu and his chiefs directed the conquest. This value describes formal government direction, not the force or harm of the campaign.

traits.label: Legal and property machinery
traits.highMeans: More formal title transfer, expropriation, surveying, registration, and legal instrumentation.
traits.reviewReason: Sources describe measured land plots, taxes, and changes in land control. The range retains evidence gaps. It does not measure the share of land taken.

traits.label: Settler implantation
traits.highMeans: A larger, more family-complete, self-reproducing, and durable incoming resident population.
traits.reviewReason: Some established Tongan residents and warriors who stayed received land. The sources do not establish the size or family structure of the incoming population. This row supports a range, not a solid point.

traits.label: Elimination over incorporation
traits.highMeans: More removal and demographic replacement, with less incorporation of the prior population.
traits.reviewReason: Many residents and chiefs remained under changed rule. The share of residents removed is unknown. The estimate does not support a solid point or show that removal was absent.
